title: Renewal from a new square: a chasing piece that steps away and still attacks the target renews the chase
rationale: The black chariot alternates b5/d5 against the unprotected white horse, attacking it up the d-file from d5 and then, having stepped away to b5, along rank 5; under the accepted renewal rule a chase renews when the piece attacks the target from the square it now occupies and did not attack it from that square before the move, so every black move renews and Black loses at the third occurrence. No ply is a check, which isolates the chase from perpetual check, and Red sustains no chase of its own because its horse threatens the chariot from d6 but not from f5.
